column1: # Delivery time against distance and number of stops
# The terms are the same everywhere; what each term is WORTH is not. A minute
# per kilometre in the city is not a minute per kilometre on the highway
# stop costs far more on a highway route than on a suburban one.
# Fitted per group you get three usable lines. Pooled with -g '*' you get one
# line that describes none of the three.
